headword: {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}

definitions.gloss: collective responsibility; joint liability; shared responsibility
definitions.explanation: The principle that all members of a group share responsibility for the actions of any individual member. Used both as a legal term (joint liability) and in everyday contexts (group punishment or shared blame).

examples.japanese: チーム{全体|ぜんたい}の{連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}だ。
examples.english: It's the collective responsibility of the whole team.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}のミスで{部署|ぶしょ}{全員|ぜんいん}が{連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}を{取|と}らされた。
examples.english: The entire department was held collectively responsible for one person's mistake.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}で{一人|ひとり}が{悪|わる}いことをすると、クラス{全体|ぜんたい}が{連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}で{叱|しか}られることがある。
examples.english: At school, when one person does something wrong, the whole class is sometimes scolded as a matter of collective responsibility.

notes:
A compound of {連帯|れんたい} (solidarity, joint) and {責任|せきにん} (responsibility). This concept is deeply embedded in Japanese group culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}を{取|と}る (to take collective responsibility)
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}を{負|お}う (to bear joint liability)
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}を{問|と}う (to hold collectively responsible)
- {連帯責任|れんたいせきにん}を{取|と}らされる (to be made to take collective responsibility)

In legal contexts, {連帯|れんたい}{債務|さいむ} (joint and several obligation) is the formal equivalent. In everyday Japanese, the concept is frequently encountered in schools, sports teams, and workplaces, where a group may be punished for the actions of one member.
